precepts.text: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands. Those were the false witnesses; they overheard his teachings and lied on him.
precepts.point: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up. Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
precepts.why:
Christ said, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up”, and the Jews answered, “Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?” They thought he meant the building.

At his trial the false witnesses brought it back: “We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.” They had overheard his teachings, and they lied on him. He never said he would destroy the temple made with hands.

Even their lie points to the truth: another temple “made without hands.” The temple Christ spoke of raising up in three days was not stone at all. It was his own body, and that is what the rest of the scriptures read here make plain.

precepts.point: It will come to a point where the words of the scripture themselves, harlot, sodomite, the law that a man should not lie with mankind, are treated as hate crimes, so a teacher must stay in the scriptures and not use his own words.

note.label: Acts 6: The Grecians Were Greek-Speaking Israelites

precepts.why:
They “set up false witnesses” who said Stephen “ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law”, though he had not. It is the same pattern used against Christ: “the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.” “many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together”, and certain rose up saying, “We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.” False witnesses, and their stories did not even agree.

This is why we teach only the words of the bible. When they bring an accusation, we can answer that we spoke nothing but what is written in the same bible they swear on in court and read in their churches.

It will come to a point where the words of the scripture themselves, harlot, sodomite, the law that a man should not lie with mankind, are treated as hate crimes. So a teacher must stay in the scriptures and not use his own words.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why:
“And some began to spit on him,” They began to spit on Christ. “and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.” They started to beat the hell out of Christ and spit on him and mock him.

“And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:” One of the maids: this is an Israelite woman. “And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.” How did she know? She obviously was following, and she knew who was with Christ. Everybody that sits in here ain't right. Remember what happened over in England: some of the same kind of sisters sat amongst us, then ran to the court and said Captain Isaac was one of them, look at Captain Asa, pointed the brothers out, and gave the layout of the school, the schematics of the school. You can't make this stuff up. These are the same souls back today. Remember they wanted to get all the followers of Christ, not just Christ; so this woman said, you were a follower of Christ too: take him, kill him. “But he denied,” Peter said, oh hell no; he got so scared and terrified, and the Lord told him he was going to do that. “saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew. And a maid saw him again,” Again: this is another woman now. “and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.” This woman did the same thing: he's one of them. “And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.”

This shows you these two women who obviously followed Christ around, watched and saw who came into the congregations, and they were not there for anything good. Everybody in here ain't right. Like that woman on YouTube putting up all our pictures, this one is evil and that one is evil, with her tattoo and her breasts showing, evil as hell, using blue lipstick to hide the herpes sore, and saying I'm saved and I'm sanctified and God is going to save me. No. The same spirits, those women that came against Christ, are back today, and some of you are making the mistake of marrying them when we tell you she is not ready; sure enough you hook up with the sister and now you have voodoo books in your house, paper in your shoes, a coconut under your bed, salt in the corner and a pigeon head hanging on your roof. Crazy. Men and women betrayers, and they are here now. Stay in the spirit.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:
When he walked the earth he did not have white hair. Here is the proof. Christ was between 30 and 33. Imagine the young dudes that age with a head full of white hair; you would spot them out quick: hey, this dude is in his early 30s and he has a head full of white hair on his head and in his beard, he had a hard life, something ain't right with him.

“Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand. And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders. And he that betrayed him had given them a token,” Token means sign. “saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.” Why did he have to give a sign as to who was Christ? Because he looked like the rest of them. All they would have had to say is, that young guy, the 30-year-old with white hair, that's him; you would spot this dude quick. But he couldn't be spotted; you could not identify him from the rest of them. So Judas said, the one I kiss is him.

“And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him. And they laid their hands on him, and took him.” They knew that was the one they were supposed to get. Many people saw Christ; he was in the temple overthrowing the tables. But when he got around the rest of them, the twelve apostles, it was like, which one is he? They all were around a similar age, same look; nobody looked starkly different.

points: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born. That is cold blooded. It is better that the man that betrays had never been born. Now I want to say this: can a betrayer repent? Yes. Will the betrayer still have to answer to God? Yes.
